charts.label: Bare-Speed against #475 and #478 at 16K
charts.alt: Grouped bars of decode tok/s at 16,384 tokens, the Optimized-Speed pack beside the Bare-Speed pack, one colour family each
charts.caption: _Decode tok/s at 16,384 tokens. The two colour families are the two model packs: blues are Optimized-Speed (release 2.11.2 acceptance mode off 71.97, #475 (base) acceptance mode off 82.84, #478 typical 0.2 99.16) and the warm bars are Bare-Speed (release acceptance mode off 67.80, #475 (base) acceptance mode off 78.39, #478 on Bare-Speed typical 0.2 84.70, this PR acceptance mode off 79.84, this PR typical 0.2 89.25, cascade OPT alpha 0.5 121.48, cascade TokenV3 alpha 0.95 103.98). Every #478 and #488 comparison bar is at typical 0.2, the comparison threshold used across this set of pull requests; the typical-0.09 figures stay in the four-arm A/B/C/D tables. Bar height is the fastest seed and the whisker is the min-max band. HumanEval strict pass@1 is annotated on the two arms measured on this pack, both with acceptance mode off._

charts.label: Bare-Speed against #475 and #478 by context
charts.alt: Decode tok/s against context size from 1,024 to 261,120 tokens for #475 and #478 on both packs and this pull request on Bare-Speed
charts.caption: _Decode tok/s against context size for #475 (base) and #478 on the Optimized-Speed pack (acceptance mode off and typical 0.2), #475 (base) and #478 on the Bare-Speed pack (acceptance mode off and typical 0.2), and this pull request on Bare-Speed at typical acceptance 0.2. Every #478 and #488 line is at typical 0.2, the comparison threshold used across this set of pull requests. Each point is the fastest seed and the band is the min-max range. At 261,120 the three Bare-Speed arms carry a point and the two Optimized-Speed arms do not: they exceed the memory knob on the #475 base without #482._
